step1.text: The user configures Rhea as the lead and four peers across different providers
step1.evidence: core scenario story: Rhea leads; Mira on Codex, Oren on OpenCode, Pia on Grok Build, Quinn on Antigravity

step2.text: All employees begin dormant; one is disabled
step2.evidence: core scenario story: roster.get shows four dormant and Quinn disabled before any session starts

step3.text: The user starts a project conversation with Rhea
step3.evidence: core scenario story runs the conversation projectless; the project-scoped conversation and worktree are conversation-delivery.ps1 and task-delegation-graph.ps1

step4.text: Rhea receives a current roster and proposes a multi-part plan
step4.evidence: core scenario story: employees_list then two task_delegate calls inside the lead turn, and a third in a follow-up turn once the first plan finished

step5.text: Under ask mode, Lazoo presents precise delegation approvals
step5.evidence: core scenario story: both children are proposed, counted by the Inbox, and accepted by the user; provider permission approvals are approval-gate.ps1

step6.text: Approved employees activate into independent native sessions and editing worktrees
step6.evidence: core scenario story: each accepted task runs on a fresh session for Mira in its own workspace, the session stops with its turn, and the next queued task wakes when she is free; Git worktrees are automatic-task-dispatch.ps1

step7.text: An employee asks a peer a direct clarification without routing through Rhea

step8.text: The disabled employee is not selected and cannot receive dispatch
step8.evidence: core scenario story: task_delegate to Quinn is refused LZ-TASK-ASSIGNEE-UNAVAILABLE and writes nothing

step9.text: One provider stalls after accepting work; Lazoo detects missing progress, retries safely, then raises a clean incident
step9.evidence: core scenario story raises the stall as the daemon would; detection and bounded retry are conversation-delivery.ps1 and minimum-incidents.ps1

step10.text: The threshold notifies Rhea, allows bounded remediation, and escalates to the user when unresolved
step10.evidence: core scenario story: the stall on the queued third task opens the lead window, the lead cancels it in its notice turn, the stall recurs, the sweep escalates to the user, and the user acknowledges it from the Inbox

step11.text: Lazoo restarts during an in-flight message and reconciles without losing or duplicating the logical task
step11.evidence: core scenario story restarts with the prior boot owner-lost and every task kept once; the in-flight attempt is message_restart_reconciles_an_uncertain_attempt in collaboration-bus.ps1 and native-session-ownership.ps1

step12.text: Results include commits, verification, task links, messages, incidents, and concise memory records
step12.evidence: task links, messages, and incidents are result-delivery.ps1; commits and verification evidence need the worker to report them; memory records need Stage 5

step13.text: Integration follows configured authority and never overwrites dirty user work

step14.text: Employees return to idle and suspend after policy timeout
step14.evidence: core scenario story: Mira idles after warm and is suspended once her one-minute timeout passes

step15.text: Lazoo remains inside its measured resource budget
